Well known Japanese hot pot franchise, very good but a bit pricey
Apr 2018
This is a well known franchise coming from Japan. Quality is good, no question. Delighted to see a wide selection of very fresh vegetables and all you can eat sukiyaki, shabu shabu, and spicy hot pot. Excellent for family dining. Despite of its price (~400K VND per person including drink), this place is often full of local Vietnamese as well as foreigners. 

If you want all you can eat style hot pots, there will be other places with better price performance. I still come here for I come here often because of its consistent quality and services.

All You Can Eat Shabu Shabu And Sukiyaki
Jan 2016
This is an international chain and I've eaten at a few locations in Tokyo. For those unfamiliar with Shabu Shabu, it's essentially a heated pot of broth that you soak vegetables in and dip meat. Most courses are all you can eat. You choose your own veggies from the buffet and the server will bring you more meat when you run out. You will leave full and happy.
